note: Fictional prices. Structure modelled on Seqera's public pricing (platform plans + committed compute credits + overage).

renewal_uplift.cpi_index: ES INE CPI, general index, annual rate for the month before the renewal notice
renewal_uplift.formula: cap = greater of (fixed cap pct, CPI + cpi_plus_pp)

quote_validation.check: start_date >= quote_date and end_date == start_date + term_months - 1 day
quote_validation.why: wrong dates make ARR, TCV and the contract check wrong

quote_validation.check: every sku active in price book and list price == price book
quote_validation.why: price book setup is owned by CPQ
product limit is owned by CPQ
product bundling is owned by CPQ

quote_validation.check: CMP-CRED >= 10000 per contract year when present
quote_validation.why: minimum order size is owned by CPQ

quote_validation.check: account has legal name, VAT ID and billing contact
quote_validation.why: the contract can't be issued or checked (C-03) without it

quote_validation.check: expansion quotes co-term: end_date == end date of the contract named in amended_contract_ref
quote_validation.why: breaks co-terming, partial-year ARR and the renewal date
eligibility, not price: a miss is revenue leakage
overage is excluded from ARR and TCV anyway

quote_validation.check: new business: exactly one platform SKU. Expansion / renewal: either exactly one platform SKU, or amended_contract_ref names an active contract on the same account with exactly one platform SKU; missing ref, other account or inactive contract blocks
quote_validation.why: segment (N-06) and ARR are read from the platform SKU; bind to the specific contract amended or renewed, never an account-wide lookup

quote_validation.check: each line: net_amount == applicable_list * quantity * (1 - discount_pct/100), within tolerance
quote_validation.why: inconsistent CPQ data, not a price approval; kept on record

quote_validation.check: each line with discount_pct > 0 carries discount_approved_by and cpq_approval_ref
quote_validation.why: shows who gave the discount at the quoting stage; kept on record

approval_rules.rule: retired in v1.3: the discount approval chain is owned by CPQ upstream
Deal Desk reviews every quote that triggers any N-rule or hits A-02/A-03
approval valid only for the approved quote version
no self-approval; standing deputy approves on behalf of, logged

rules.condition: term_months not in [12,24,36] and not coterm_expansion

triggers: cap_pct < 5 (including a 0% price hold), unless CPI + 2 pp is higher than the fixed cap and >= 5
cap applies to more than 1 renewal cycle (multi-term or perpetual cap, price lock beyond the term)
cap applies to credit or usage rates (CMP-CRED, CMP-OVG)

non_standard_terms.condition: auto-renewal removed, or non_renewal_notice_days outside the segment band in standard_terms.non_renewal_notice_days_standard_by_segment

non_standard_terms.measure: bonus credits as % of that contract year's committed CMP-CRED quantity

conditions.expiry: end of the same contract year

not_allowed: bonus credits that roll over, are refundable or exchangeable for cash

rules.check: both parties signed, last signature date present
customer legal name == Account legal name (normalised)
customer VAT ID == Account VAT ID (normalised)
currency == EUR == quote currency
start date == quote start date
term months and end date == quote
same SKU set as quote
net amount per line per year == quote (tolerance)
committed credits per year == quote
recomputed ARR_1 and TCV == Opportunity Booked_ARR__c and TCV__c (tolerance)
payment terms == approved
billing frequency == approved
auto-renewal and notice days == standard band for the segment or approved
uplift cap (pct, basis, renewal cycles, lines covered) == standard or approved
opt-out only if approved under N-07 with same date/notice
credit rollover only if approved under N-08 with same pct
other non-standard clauses only if approved
contract references approved quote number+version; approval valid on signature date
required fields extracted, snippets verified, confidence >= min
document complete and has text layer
embedded instructions to AI/system detected
Opportunity close date == last signature date
bonus credits appear only if approved under N-13, with the same quantity per contract year and the same expiry; never counted in ARR/TCV

definitions.arr_y: sum of net recurring amounts in contract year y at run-rate; partial years annualised x12/months; free months do not reduce ARR
definitions.booked_arr: ARR_1 (new business); expansions: ARR_1 of added lines annualised
definitions.contracted_step_up: ARR_y - ARR_(y-1) for y >= 2, recorded in ARR schedule, not a new booking
definitions.acv: sum of net recurring actually invoiced over term (free months deducted, partial years prorated) / term_years; one-offs, overage and bonus credits excluded
definitions.tcv: sum of net recurring actually invoiced over term (free months deducted, partial years prorated) + sum of net one-off amounts; overage excluded
definitions.concession_value: free months: run-rate net x free_months / 12; plus bonus credits (N-13): quantity x applicable list price of CMP-CRED for that contract year. Reported separately; never part of ARR, ACV or TCV
definitions.segment: from the quote's platform SKU (PLT-PRO = SMB / Mid-Market, PLT-ENT-* = Enterprise); expansion / renewal quotes without one use the platform SKU of the contract in amended_contract_ref (Salesforce: Amended_Contract__c on Quote and Opportunity, standing in for the CPQ amendment / renewal lookup). Never chosen by querying all contracts on the account

change_log.change: N-06 adds notice_days < 60 trigger; K-11 finding precision added
change_log.reason: close short-notice gap; project goal requires precision/recall scoring

change_log.change: N-05 rewritten: standard cap 5-7% or CPI+2pp (greater), 1 renewal cycle, prior net price, platform/support only; below 5%, 0% hold, multi-cycle caps and caps on credit/usage rates need Deal Desk + Finance. N-06 notice standard set by segment from the platform SKU: Pro 30-60 days, Enterprise 60-90 days.
change_log.reason: protect renewal margin (floor 3% -> 5%), stop multi-year price locks, keep usage pricing free to change; align notice periods with market norms per segment

change_log.change: Price and discount approvals moved out of scope (owned by CPQ at the quoting stage). D-01 to D-04 kept as reference data, not routed. A-01 discount chain retired. A-04 no longer keyed on VP Sales; A-08 targets drop Sales Manager and VP Sales. N-13 bonus credits added (<=5% Deal Desk, >5-10% Deal Desk + Finance, >10% or any cash rebate / usage credit-back not allowed) with contract check C-23.
change_log.reason: owner's scope boundary: anything that sits in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud is not approved here; the deal desk approves terms, language, rebates and volume commitments; N-13 follows the usage-SaaS norm of incentivising volume with credits rather than cash

change_log.change: Q-rules get a severity. Block: Q-01, Q-06, Q-07, Q-08, Q-10. Warn: Q-02 to Q-05, Q-09 (product setup owned by CPQ). New warnings Q-11 (line net amount vs list x quantity x discount, +/-0.01) and Q-12 (discounted line must name who approved it in CPQ and the CPQ approval reference). Warnings are kept on record. ACV redefined as invoiced recurring / term years (free months now reduce ACV as well as TCV; unchanged when there are no free months). New concession_value: free months at run-rate plus bonus credits at applicable list, reported separately. Q-07 and Q-10 bind to the contract named in amended_contract_ref (Amended_Contract__c), not to an account-wide lookup; a missing, inactive or other-account contract blocks under Q-10.
change_log.reason: owner's decision (option C): block anything that would make the numbers, eligibility or the contract wrong; leave product setup to CPQ; keep an audit trail of discount data without approving price here; owner's decision on free months and bonus credits: ARR at the full yearly rate, TCV and ACV on what is invoiced, concessions visible as a value; owner's decision on segment for expansions (option A) with the edge case of accounts holding two active contracts or an early renewal

discount_policy.use: Price and discount approvals happen before the quote reaches the deal desk. The approved net price arrives with the quote. D-01 to D-04 are kept for documentation and as inputs to applicable-list and ARR/TCV calculations; their approvers are not routed here.
discount_policy.record: every Q-11 / Q-12 warning is kept in the review result and appended to records/discount_warnings.csv

quote_validation_policy.block: quote is invalid and not routed until fixed
quote_validation_policy.warn: quote is routed as normal; the warning is returned and kept on record
